_comment: Pairs kept out of EVERY split -- training, validation and holdout alike.
This is a curation decision, so it lives in git and is reviewed in pull requests,
not in DVC. Exclude a pair only when the two texts are not a translation of each
other; a pair that is merely unusual belongs in the Tier A review queue that
Removing a pair does NOT move any other pair between splits: assignment is
sha256(salt:id) per document, so the other 778 keep the split they already had.
Keys are pair ids, values say why. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
0013: Not a translation. Source is a 309-word overview of addiction risks for people with disabilities; the Leichte Sprache text is a 180-word description of two different brochures about smoking and cannabis. Same topic, different content.
0224: Not a translation. 690 words of job adverts reduced to a 19-word list of the roles being advertised. That is a summary, and training on it teaches the model to drop content.
